hints.content:
The *scale factor* in a dilation changes every length in the figure and changes the distance of each point from the center of dilation.

$\dfrac{\text{length of image}}{\text{length of source}}=\text{scale factor}$

Segment $\overline{AE}$ has a length of $4$ units.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A first quadrant coordinate plane. The image and pre-image of pentagons are graphed. The pre-image pentagon has vertices A at four, zero, B at four, two, C at zero, four, D at two, four, and E at eight, zero. The image pentagon has vertices A prime at six, five, B prime at six, eight, C prime at zero, eleven, D prime at three, eleven, and E prime at twelve, five.
